## 治理元数据

- **PR 类型**: feature
- **任务 ID**: M5-007
- **风险等级**: R2
- **责任人**: @Chengyue-Lu
- **工作流目录**: docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M5-SYSTEM-EVALUATION-DESIGN

## 范围与非目标

H4b adds bounded synthetic anonymous review packages, separate private source/projection mappings, externally named Human Review freezes and controlled reveal. Every entrypoint independently replays H4a evidence; all planned slices, including failures and unused retries, remain in the review set.

Draft dependency: PR #90 remains OPEN awaiting review at b9ad97ebf256351dd5e1540d5e688087394d474d. This branch starts from that candidate, targets develop per repository topology, and therefore includes PR90 commits until it is accepted and this PR is rebased. H4b changes begin after that commit. Do not merge this draft before #90 acceptance and subsequent exact-base validation/review.

H4c metric/analysis input, H5 closeout, live execution and release are subsequent work. M5-007 remains IN_PROGRESS; no Human score, admission, Task completion or scientific result is generated.

## 契约与权威影响

- **共享契约**: yes
- **权威、权限或数据边界**: yes

Seven new Evaluation-owned @1.0.0 record kinds have strict schemas. Public packages expose only controlled synthetic instruction/rubric, random anonymous IDs, reference integers, integer answers and availability. Exact source-to-projection approval, named review authorization, freeze and reveal authority are required external callbacks. Expected artifact pins and observed times are supplied again for cold replay. New schema catalog identity requires compatible fresh evidence; frozen historical archives are preserved.

## TASKS 状态变更

none

## 验证证据

- H4b: 13 focused PASS, including real four-arm evidence and fresh-process replay with execution forbidden; 141/141 statements and 12/12 branches covered.
- H4a dependency regression: 2 PASS, including all slices/retry and blocked/unstarted closure.
- Registration/Schema/Trace exporter/documentation/coverage contracts: 53 PASS; CI consumer/shadow/docs: 31 PASS.
- Repository: 186 checked, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Package: four clean install probes PASS; wheel/sdist-wheel resource identity.
- Source-pinned evidence is retained in `docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M5-SYSTEM-EVALUATION-DESIGN/attempts/M5-007-H4B-001`.
- Coverage is scoped to this change. Hosted full/global CI runs asynchronously; no hosted PASS or cross-owner acceptance is claimed.

## 剩余风险与后续

Review format is deliberately limited to bounded synthetic integer artifacts; arbitrary free-text anonymization and live Human scoring are not implemented. Callers keep private mappings/reviews separate and distribute mappings only after validated reveal; this library is not an ACL or distribution service. PR90 dependency acceptance and later H4c/H5 remain outstanding.

## 权威依据

User requested implementing H4b in a separate draft PR while PR90 waits for review. 路诚钺 owns M5 Evaluation semantics and Task scope; 黄毅 reviews Execution interfaces. The accepted M5-007 Task and H4 packet authorize this evaluation layer. External named authorities retain review/admission decisions. No merge exception is requested or inherited.

## 对抗性证据

Tests reject public labels, paths, extra body/embedded metadata, unsupported artifact formats, duplicate/missing aliases and reviews, unnamed or untrusted reviewers, absent/truthy-only verifier results, invalid trusted times, early reveal, changed scores/mappings reused with a freeze, forged H4a summaries and source/validator drift. A fresh process validates the four-arm chain with Provider/Host/project execution forbidden. Synthetic reviewer fixtures are sequence tests only.

Refs #55
